Set after the Megaman NT series (Battle Network on GBA), mixing elements from the Anime Series and the Game Series, a cute gaiden comic about oujo-sama lite Yai Ayanokoji, her priviledged life (with all the duties and obligations) and the one issue that pricks her since ever: her huge forehead!

WIP COMIC.
